log.title: Legacy software Ltd is incorporated
log.text: Medium difficulty. You hold 100% of the shares and £50,000 in the bank. Sell a subscription product to small businesses. No inventory, ~88% gross margin, but developers are expensive and customers churn if the product falls behind. 30% of customers prepay annually, creating deferred revenue.

log.title: Competitor launches a better product
log.text: NimbusWorks launches a major upgrade (quality +12). Your preference share will fall unless you invest in quality or price.

log.title: Stackly launches a new product
log.text: Stackly's quality jumped by 3 points. Time to look at your own product.

log.title: New financial year
log.text: Salaries rose 3% with inflation. New acquisition targets are available in the M&A tab.

log.title: Wage inflation
log.text: A tight labour market pushes salaries up 6%, permanently.

log.title: A big customer wants a bulk deal
log.text: You chose "Sign 53 customers". Signed. £23,050 invoiced and held as deferred revenue, released £1,921 a month.
